summary: Info Sheet #68 - Investor / Stakeholder Reporting Suite tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (KPI snapshot returns full users/revenue/engagement/conversion schema with ARR=MRR*12; non-admin GET/POST -> 403; unauth -> 403; generate report persists with title/tldr/sections>=1/metrics_table/asks/risks/kpi_snapshot and created_by=admin email; get report returns full doc incl. kpi_snapshot; list contains newly created id; get unknown -> 404; delete ok + subsequent GET 404; delete unknown -> 404; ask endpoint returns {answer, supporting_metrics}; ask empty -> 400; ask non-admin -> 403). Frontend E2E mobile 390x844: admin login (Diyhomieapp@gmail.com) -> /admin -> admin-nav-investor click -> InvestorModule renders 'Investor Reporting' h1, 'Live KPIs updated HH:MM UTC' subtitle, Growth section (Total users 123 / Active 30d 49 / New 30d 123 / MoM growth 100%), Revenue section (MRR/ARR/ARPU/Paying/Net/Cash/Runway/Churn), Engagement (Projects 76 / Completed 3.9% / Free->Paid 0% / Referrals / Blog 6 / Communities 12 / Certs 4 / Pros 3). Chip inv-period-quarterly selectable (orange highlight). inv-generate click -> ~10s wait -> report detail view: back arrow (inv-back), title 'DIYhomie Q2 2026 Investor Update', period/audience/date meta, tldr card, metrics_table (6 rows), sections (User Growth / Revenue Quality / Engagement Metrics / etc.), inv-delete button. inv-back returns to list; a saved report row (testID inv-report-<id>) is visible. Delete flow: open row -> tap inv-delete -> report removed & list refreshed. Q&A: inv-question typed ('What is our current runway and MRR?'), inv-ask tapped, response returned and answer card rendered.

issues: Admin nav is a horizontal-scrolling tab strip; 'Investor Reporting' tab needed to be scrolled into view (consistent with prior admin modules, not a blocker).
Stat card labels use font-size 9 which is below the 11-12px readable minimum on mobile; consider bumping to 10-11 for accessibility. Not a blocker.

action_items: No fixes required for Sheet #68 - feature is production-ready.

(Observational, cross-module) Overview module shows MRR $89 while Investor KPI + finance/summary show MRR $0. investor_engine correctly mirrors /admin/finance/summary logic (subscription_status=='active'); the Overview module appears to use a different data source (subscription_tier presence). Not in scope for #68 but worth reconciling in a future iteration for founder-facing consistency.
(Optional cleanup, unrelated) Expo package version drift persists: expo 54.0.34->54.0.35, expo-font 14.0.11->14.0.12, expo-router 6.0.23->6.0.24. `npx expo install --check` when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: investor_engine.py is well-scoped (~281 lines, single-responsibility) and uses configure() dependency injection cleanly (db, logger, llm_json, plan_tiers).
All Mongo reads project out `_id`; list endpoint additionally strips `sections`+`kpi_snapshot` to keep the row payload light -- good.
Admin router uses router-level Depends(require_admin) so every endpoint (kpis, reports GET/POST, get-by-id, delete, ask) is auth-guarded; non-admin correctly gets 403 (confirmed by tests).
compute_kpis mirrors /admin/finance/summary revenue math and freezes the KPI snapshot into each saved report -- solid paper-trail design.
LLM prompts are strict JSON with clearly enumerated keys; graceful 502 fallback when LLM fails or returns no sections (tested via generate happy-path only; error branch not exercised).

InvestorModule.tsx uses only React Native primitives (View/Text/Pressable/ScrollView/TextInput/ActivityIndicator), StyleSheet.create, and testIDs on every interactive element (inv-generate, inv-ask, inv-question, inv-highlights, inv-back, inv-delete, inv-refresh, inv-period-*, inv-report-*). Good.
Small polish: `Alert.alert` used for error branches; on web these do not surface but on native they will. Acceptable.
`useFocusEffect` correctly re-loads KPIs+reports when the module regains focus.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests created and cleaned up one 'monthly investors' report via the API. One additional 'Monthly Update - July 2026' report generated by the UI flow was subsequently deleted via the inv-delete button in the same session.
